summary: Phase 6 (declared equipment features) validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed — PUT with features {pool:enterree, single_storey:true, heating:fioul, dpe:F, garage:un} produces feat_pool +0.06, feat_single_storey +0.03, feat_heating -0.04, feat_dpe -0.09, feat_garage +0.03, features persist, hedonic.factors contains 'features'; clearing features removes feat_* adjustments; surface=5 returns 422; unknown id 404; POST for appartement Blois with {floor:4, elevator:false, balcony:true, parking:true, fenced:true} yields feat_floor -0.04, feat_balcony +0.03, feat_parking +0.04, fenced ignored (maison-only); report.pdf still 200. Frontend: wizard /new has 4 steps (Adresse, Le bien, Détails, Équipements) with FeaturesForm rendered on step 4; feat-heating-*, feat-dpe-C, feat-bathrooms-plus, feat-balcony-oui, feat-parking-oui, feat-floor-plus present; estimate-submit-button creates the property and adjustments-card shows the expected labels; edit-property-button opens /property/{id}/edit prefilled (surface=120, rooms=5), toggling feat-fenced-oui and feat-gate-oui and tapping edit-save-button persists 'Terrain clos' and 'Portail motorisé' adjustments; home list and hedonic-card / final-estimate-card render.

integration_issues.issue: After edit-save-button, router.back() logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' when the edit page was opened directly (deep link / reload) without a preceding detail-screen entry. Not user-facing in normal navigation (Home → Detail → Edit works), but the save should probably fall back to router.replace(`/property/${id}`) when there is no history. Reference: /app/frontend/app/property/[id]/edit.tsx:65

action_items: Optional UX polish: in /app/frontend/app/property/[id]/edit.tsx onSuccess, use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace(`/property/${id}`) to avoid the GO_BACK dev warning on deep-linked reloads.
